text:
sasha: Quick heads-up — kicking off Caldera-9B bring-up on runtime-staging. First smoke passed but saw weird attention drift when KV cache evicts mid-seq. Sharing initial notes and logs below.

lee: Can you paste the failing prompt and the diff in logits / KV ops?

sasha: Short repro:
```
# prompt
"Translate to Farsi: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."
# run flags
--seq-len 1024 --kv-spill-threshold 64 --quant q4_0
```
Observed: coherent until token ~210 then repeats partial phrase and truncates early. Runtime logs: 
```
kv_evict at step 213 node=shard-2
attn_scores spike at layer 20
stack: runtime/serve/alloc.cc:152 free_block unexpectedly null
```

aj: Hmm. Did you try disabling rotary_fused or using legacy RoPE codepath? Might be an interaction with q4 kernel or packing.

sasha: Yes — toggled rotary_fused=false and behavior changes: no early repeat but overall fluency slightly worse. So looks RoPE-path sensitive.

maria: Minimal checklist to triage: 1) reproduce on non-GPU quant path (CPU sim) 2) run KV stress with a synthetic long stream and forced spills 3) dump KV tensors and attention scores per layer 4) run the rotary slice unit tests and golden outputs.

lee: I'll run synthetic KV stream on a small shard tomorrow (staging-node-7). Will push a script: `scripts/kv-stress.sh --len 5000 --spill 64`.

aj: I'll run quant-level compare across q8/q4_0/q4_1 and diff logits at layer 0/10/20. If the mismatch is small it could be accumulation error; if big then kernel bug.

maria: tagging @infra-qa for logs retention.
infra-bot: retention request received — extended logs for `caldera-9b` to 7 days.

sasha: Also saw a small perplexity regression vs baseline-7b when using q4_0 on >1k context slices. Will add eval set and sample outputs to repo.

aj: Good. If reproducible across kernels, schedule a deep trace with the profiler and capture the rotation matrices and post-dequant tensors.

lee: Quick triage idea: maybe a sign-mismatch in quant dequant when applying sin/cos rotations — a tiny bias can compound over tokens. Try storing rotations in fp16 instead of int8/packed and re-run.

sasha: Adding notes to the bring-up doc and will roll an A/B canary on Dedicated with automatic fallback to baseline if eval metrics regress >2% PPL. Opening a PR with logs + small harness.

maria: Thanks — please include the synthetic repro script and the exact runtime flags in the PR so SRE can replay. :+1:

deploy-bot: Created GH issue #4821: caldera-9b-kv-rope-quant-quirk, assigned to eng-ml.

sasha: Will drop the initial reproducible artifact (dump tarball + short README) in this thread in ~1h; ping if you want immediate access.
